notifications.joinWaitlistBody:
The lobby is full. You'll be queued in order.

If a seat opens, you'll be moved in automatically. The host may also open another group when every group is full.

We'll send you a Discord DM when you get a seat.
notifications.editNotifyBody: Saving will send Discord DMs about changes to the date/time, tracks, and/or car rules. Waitlisted racers are notified only when the date or time changes.
notifications.dmSetupBody: Discord can only DM you when you share a server with FORZA.EVENTS. Add the bot to a server you manage, then return here and try again.

route.devHint: Something threw while rendering this page. Check the console and the details below.
route.devChunkHint: Common after HMR or a bad save while Vite is running. Hard-refresh the tab (or restart the dev server), then try again.

discordGate.body: Forza Events runs as a Discord Activity. Add the app in Discord, then open it from the App Launcher or a server voice channel.

legal.englishAuthoritative: The English text on this page is authoritative. UI translations elsewhere in the app do not replace these terms.

participation.xboxHintBody: On Xbox, add convoy leader {{leader}} as a friend and join their convoy shortly before the event starts.
participation.convoyLeaderXboxHintBody: On Xbox, accept friend requests from racers. Make your profile visible and set Forza convoy privacy to Friends so they can join. After the race, send a screenshot of the results to the host.

addGroup.title: Add group {{n}}
addGroup.description: Pick a convoy leader for the new group. Racers from the waitlist, other groups (not convoy leaders), or the host (if not already a convoy leader) can be chosen. Anyone on the waitlist is moved into the new group; vacated seats are backfilled from the waitlist.
addGroup.pickLeader: Pick a convoy leader for the new group.
addGroup.gamertagRequired: This leader needs an Xbox gamertag.

changeGroupLeader.title: Change convoy leader
changeGroupLeader.description: Pick from the list or search your server. This group and the new leader get a Discord DM.
changeGroupLeader.gamertagRequired: This leader needs an Xbox gamertag.
changeGroupLeader.guildSearchDisabled: Group is full — pick a driver from the list.

groupRoster.introUneven: Drivers are spread unevenly across groups. Convoy leaders stay put.
groupRoster.introBalance: Move drivers from fuller groups into lighter ones until every group has the same count.
groupRoster.introBalanceShuffle: Even out group sizes, then randomly mix drivers.
groupRoster.introShuffle: Randomly mix drivers between groups. Each group keeps the same headcount.
groupRoster.notifyWarning: Moved racers will receive a Discord DM.
groupRoster.unchanged: No moves needed for this action.
groupRoster.shuffleUnchanged: No seating change found. Try again.
groupRoster.unavailableTip: No moves available. Need at least two drivers who are not convoy leaders.
groupRoster.balanceHint: Move drivers from fuller groups to lighter ones until counts match.
groupRoster.balanceShuffleHint: Even out groups, then randomly mix drivers.
groupRoster.shuffleHint: Randomly reassign drivers across groups. Same count in each group.
